SELECT c.slug, (c.settings -> 'enabled_modules' ->> 'inteligencia_ia') AS modulo_ia,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM public.lead_insights i WHERE i.company_id = c.id) AS analises,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM public.weekly_insight_runs r WHERE r.company_id = c.id) AS resumos,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies p WHERE p.tablename IN ('lead_insights', 'weekly_insight_runs')) AS politicas,
 (SELECT length(coalesce(s.handoff_alert_phone, '')) >= 10 FROM ai_agent_settings s WHERE s.company_id = c.id) AS tem_telefone_alerta,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_instances w WHERE w.company_id = c.id AND w.is_active AND w.status = 'connected') AS numeros_conectados
FROM companies c WHERE c.slug IN ('castelo-da-diversao', 'megamegic', 'planeta-divertido') ORDER BY c.slug
